integrity: All analytic finite-size identities and asymptotic remainders are proved in RESULT.md. The included numeric checker provides finite corroboration (366 assertions), not an independent proof or independent review.
scientific_limitations: Homogeneous open skew-coupled stationary Gaussian chain; T to infinity before N to infinity. Full infinite-chain rate function and uniform-in-N finite-time deviation estimates are not established. Generic finite-dimensional OU current SCGF and stationary Gaussian factorization are prior art; potential implicit coverage by broad harmonic-network asymptotics remains an originality risk.
title: A critical entropy-tilt edge with logarithmic finite-size response in a skew-coupled Gaussian chain
